required_fixes: Bound C-MEAS-VALID broadening claim to effective diversity: state explicitly that BROTLI_QUALITY_RANGE (4,5,6,7,8) selection collapses to 2 effective compressed outputs for tested payloads (quality 4 distinct vs qualities 5-8 identical) and to 1 effective output for tiny userinfo error bodies (26B uncompressed -> 30B compressed identical across all 5 qualities). Do not claim 'full 5-level distinct' validation; claim is '5-level selection tested, effective binary/ternary diversity observed for 1KB compressible JSON' - evidence: raw_observations.json unique_count valid_token 2/20 userinfo, 1/20 error, plus local brotli.compress verification 71B vs 69B collapse.

Disclose per-condition seed derivation via Python hash() (run_experiment.py:509 quality_rng = random.Random(SEED + hash(condition) % 10000)) is non-deterministic across PYTHONHASHSEED values; fix to deterministic stable hash (e.g., hashlib.sha256 or int) or log actual quality distribution per request in raw_observations.json to prove 5-level selection was sampled.

Correct report Finding 1 phrasing: 'Full 5-level does NOT increase degradation vs binary' is true only because effective diversity is unchanged (2 uniques in both experiments), not because intermediate levels were tested and found irrelevant. Report must state that intermediate levels 5,6,7 produced identical bytes to level 8 for all 5 body types tested (local verification: 5-8 identical hex), so broadening from binary {4,8} to {4,5,6,7,8} is not a stronger stress test for these payload sizes.

Explicitly gate H3: compressed-varying brotli discrimination 0.4329 on /userinfo exceeds 0.35 threshold, so H3 (compressed <0.35) is falsified on /userinfo in this setting; report correctly notes PARTIALLY SUPPORTED but spec decision_rule MIXED does not fire. Disclose that 0.4329 vs parent 0.2286 difference is inflated by error-body insensitivity (1 unique/20 for 3 error states) and by less-correlated valid_token collisions; do not present as 'less degradation than parent' without noting same effective 2-output diversity.

validity_findings.finding: Brotli 5-level collapse to effective binary: local brotli.compress verification shows for all 5 body types (userinfo valid 999B -> 71B q4 vs 69B q5-8 identical; userinfo error 26B ->30B identical all 5; introspect valid 32B ->36B q4 distinct vs q5-8 identical; introspect invalid 43B ->46B q4 vs 41B q5-8; introspect expired 43B ->46B q4 vs 43B q5-8) only 2 distinct outputs across 5 qualities (1 for tiny error). Raw evidence raw_observations.json confirms: /userinfo valid_token 2/20, error states 1/20; /introspect all states 2/20. Prereg expected 2-5 distinct per state; observed is minimal. Full 5-level selection was executed (code BROTLI_QUALITY_RANGE=(4,5,6,7,8) correct) but did not produce 5 distinct compression artefacts for these sizes.

claim_ceiling: Decompression-normalization (SHA256 on decompressed body + status via brotli.decompress after Content-Encoding:br removal) preserves body-only discrimination at structural ceiling 0.5 on /userinfo and 0.8333 on /introspect under synthetic brotli quality selection from set {4,5,6,7,8} via local Python proxy (N=20 per state, seed 44, 1KB highly compressible JSON valid body ~999B ->69-71B brotli, error 26B->30B) - result.json DECOMPRESSED-VARYING-BROTLI decompressed 0.5/0.8333. Algorithm-equivalence |gzip - brotli| =0.0 holds for this synthetic distribution, but effective brotli diversity is 2 variants (q4 vs q5-8 identical) not 5 distinct; for tiny error bodies only 1 variant. Claim is BOUNDED to: synthetic proxy with mtime=0 deterministic proxy, mock OAuth2 4 states with 3-way error collapse, single compressible payload distribution, single seed 44 with hash() non-determinism caveat. NOT justified for: real-CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) universal deployment, non-JSON or MB-scale, incompressible/random bodies where q5-7 may diverge, missing/incorrect/double Content-Encoding, production latency, or claim of 5 distinct quality-level resistance. Compressed-byte-only hashing degrades to 0.4329 on /userinfo (above 0.35 threshold, so H3 falsified here) and more importantly is body-size dependent.
